description: This file is a static analysis plugin script for checking code patches and source files, originally named 'checkpatch.pl'. It performs code style checks, linting, and various validations on source code files and patches, especially in the context of the OpenWrt project. The script includes functions for parsing diffs, patches, and source files, and generates warnings and errors based on coding standards and conventions.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script and exits.

methods.name: list_types
methods.description: Lists all message types defined in the script for code checking.

methods.name: hash_save_array_words
methods.description: Stores unique words from an array into a hash to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: hash_show_words
methods.description: Displays stored words from a hash for debugging or informational purposes.

methods.name: read_words
methods.description: Reads a list of words from a file into a string variable.

methods.name: build_types
methods.description: Builds regex patterns for different C types and modifiers to aid in source code parsing.

methods.name: deparenthesize
methods.description: Removes outer parentheses from a code string.

methods.name: seed_camelcase_file
methods.description: Scans a header or source file to identify and store camel case names.

methods.name: is_maintained_obsolete
methods.description: Checks if a source file is marked as obsolete according to the MAINTAINERS file.

methods.name: is_SPDX_License_valid
methods.description: Validates if a given license string complies with SPDX license standards.

methods.name: seed_camelcase_includes
methods.description: Seeds include header files to identify camel case names across headers.

methods.name: git_commit_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a git commit, including its hash and message.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a patch or source file for style checks, warnings, and errors.

methods.name: top_of_openwrt_tree
methods.description: Verifies if a directory is the root of an OpenWrt source tree.

methods.name: parse_email
methods.description: Parses an email string into components: name, comment, address, and comment.

methods.name: format_email
methods.description: Formats name and address into a proper email string.

methods.name: reformat_email
methods.description: Reformats an email string into a standard form.

methods.name: same_email_addresses
methods.description: Checks if two email addresses are equivalent.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Locates an executable in system PATH.

methods.name: which_conf
methods.description: Locates a configuration file in several standard locations.

methods.name: expand_tabs
methods.description: Replaces tabs with spaces according to tabstop settings.
